post_clip.description: A person enters from the left (frame 6 onward), approaches the counter where another individual is seated, and appears to interact with items on or near the counter without paying. The entrant moves deliberately, briefly obscures hands near the counter surface (frames 7–10), and then begins moving toward the exit area (frame 11–12). No visible transaction occurs, and the behavior is consistent with concealing merchandise before exiting — indicative of potential shoplifting.

Person at counter appears to be concealing an item under their shirt or in clothing while seated; repeated hand movements near torso and waist suggest covert placement of merchandise, consistent with shoplifting behavior.

A person in a patterned shirt and head covering (right side) appears to be concealing an item near the counter area while interacting with the cashier; their posture and hand movement suggest possible shoplifting—reaching toward or into clothing/bag while standing close to merchandise display. The cashier (in blue) reacts by turning and raising arms in frames 3–4, possibly indicating surprise or confrontation. Background customers remain passive, but the behavior of the individual near the exit is inconsistent with normal shopping.
